description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Instant Cast 1], [Soul Break Gauge +250], [Attach Ice with Stacking], [Awoken Rune Knight], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Glaciate Edge] to the user

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Awoken Rune Knight
description.text: Ice abilities don't consume uses, Ice abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Splendid Sword after using Ice abilities

description.name: Glaciate Edge
description.text: Grants [Quick Cast 1] to all allies in the front row after using Ice abilities
